answer_1.quote: Generative Commonsense Reasoning (GCR), an NLG model is expected to generate sentences that are both quality-bearing ... and diverse ... We conduct a comprehensive meta-evaluation of 12 diversity metrics for GCR using three standard GCR datasets.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences describing commonsense relations among input concepts

answer_2.quote: Quality evaluation typically relies on comparing generated outputs against a set of human-written reference sentences using metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, or SPICE. ... Form‑based diversity metrics such as self‑BLEU and distinct, ... content‑based diversity metrics such as self‑CosSim and Vendi‑Score ...

answer_3.quote: We follow their work and create a dataset where an LLM provides a pairwise preference rating for two sets of sentences ... We use GPT-4o as the annotator LLM ... the annotator LLM scores each set's diversity according to a five‑point scale, from highly redundant (1) to explore a wide range of aspects of the theme (5).

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 70 pairs of high‑quality sentence sets and asked five linguistically trained human annotators ... to indicate which set they judged to be more diverse. ... The average pairwise accuracy across all annotators was then computed ... achieving 80.6% agreement with the LLM annotator.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to choose the more diverse sentence set for each pair, based on redundancy and coverage of different aspects.
